policies.title: Policy & Terms
items: Free privilege: Members enrolling in packages from level 4 and above (over 2,000,000 VND) receive free Training & Healing Meditation and all monthly 7-day challenges.
Refund commitment: 100% refund for intensive programs if learners complete participation (above 80%) but do not achieve measurable body-index improvement.
Upgrade policy: Previous fee is deducted when upgrading to a higher package within 15 days from registration date.

items.q: If I buy the Core Fasting Full package, do I get training access?
items.a: Yes. From package level 4 onward, you get free daily access to Training & Healing Meditation and monthly 7-day challenges at no extra cost.

items.q: How can I earn high referral commission as an ambassador?
items.a: Once you become a Health Ambassador, entry offers like the 99K course can provide very high commission. Premium programs range around 15% to 25% depending on your ambassador tier.

items.q: Does Training & Healing Meditation include live Zoom sessions?
items.a: Yes. The program includes live daily Zoom sessions with coaches to maintain both physical discipline and mindful recovery.
